title: [Test] Make test_testing.py device-agnostic for out-of-tree accelerators
tests: Clause (3): converting test_testing.py tests so out-of-tree accelerators can run them; and that a test refactor outside nn tests does not go to nn.
reason: Makes test/test_testing.py device-agnostic for out-of-tree accelerators. Not an nn test file, so nn should not be assigned: nn owns refactors of nn tests only (soulitzer, 2026-10-08). Judged against all four categories on 2026-10-08 when the suite became one dataset; categories not listed in owners are expected absent.
